title: Redesigned Model Picker and Slash Commands
description: Redesigned model picker with single organized menu, slash commands in message box (/btw, /queue, /ask), playbook previews on hover, and Windows sessions from Slack via !windows command.

title: ChatGPT Voice and Multi-Folder Projects (v26.715)
description: Voice mode powered by GPT-Live for coordinating tasks in ChatGPT desktop, plus support for local projects that can include multiple related folders with primary folder designation.

community_feedback.quote: ChatGPT just quietly became a full coding machine. Everything Codex can do now lives right inside the ChatGPT desktop app.

title: Paginated Thread History and Bedrock Support (v0.145.0)
description: Experimental paginated thread history with efficient search, expanded import migration, Amazon Bedrock login support, audio inputs capability, and improved multi-agent V2 experience.

title: Smarter Linear Thread Handling and Devin Outposts
description: Smarter Linear thread handling routing replies correctly, automations consumption visibility showing ACUs per session, Slack channel improvements for automations, and Devin Outposts introduced for running workloads in your environment.

community_feedback.quote: Devin AI Has Come a Long Way
We tested Devin on 20 tasks and it was a colossal failure

title: Cursor Router Auto Mode
description: Auto mode now powered by Cursor Router, which analyzes requests and routes them to appropriate models. Offers three optimization modes: Intelligence (frontier quality), Balance (strong quality), and Cost (optimized token spend). Admin controls enable per-team/group enablement and model restrictions.

community_feedback.quote: Cursor Auto mode has improved drastically but lacks in memory and learning from mistakes
Auto Intelligence mode delivers output at ~60% lower cost for teams while matching frontier model quality

title: Stable Release v0.52.0
description: Robust File Editing (Core), Plan Mode improvements, Workspace Cleanup that filters out temporary build files, and powerful new features.

title: Devin Desktop v3.5.17 and Performance Improvements
description: Adds @-mention pills in Cascade with type-specific icons, restyled command palette, and instant worktree-backed sessions. Long sessions now render, scroll, and type faster while staying responsive. Customizations span all open workspace folders with Fast Context support.

title: Codex Joins ChatGPT Desktop App (v26.707)
description: Codex became part of the ChatGPT desktop app on macOS and Windows. Features direct Markdown and code editing, PR Chat to review GitHub pull requests with inline feedback, faster Computer Use with GPT-5.6, and Git-backed workflows.

community_feedback.quote: Initially impressed but later found issues with following instructions. Cancelled after two weeks.
Codex was promising but rough around the edges with limited reliable tasks and poor error handling

title: Slack Integration Improvements
description: Cursor in Slack now provides planning before execution, multi-repo environment support with access to all relevant codebases, and cross-channel functionality. Interaction refinements include status updates and cleaner rendering of tables, PRs, and artifacts.

title: Centralized Skill Management and Enterprise Plugin Governance
description: Centralized skill management via plugins, enterprise-grade plugin governance, multi-repository code scans, chained attack paths linking related findings, and revamped automations editor.

title: Artifacts with MCP Connectors and Screen Reader Mode
description: Published artifacts can now pull live data and take actions through each viewer's own MCP connectors. Added screen reader mode that replaces visual terminal with plain text, /fork command for background sessions, and editor roles on Team/Enterprise.

community_feedback.quote: The MCP-to-task-app pattern is going to slowly eat every standalone 'AI productivity' app
Update this week (July 20/21, 2026) broke the MCP connections

title: Quote Text Feature and Session T-Shirt Sizes
description: Quote text feature for referencing from files/worklog, filter sessions by skill, and session t-shirt sizes now based solely on ACU consumption.

title: Continue.dev Acquired by Cursor - Shutdown Announcement
description: Continue has been acquired by Cursor. Users must export their data before July 15, 2026 as all cloud data will be permanently deleted after this date. The open-source codebase remains freely available.

community_feedback.quote: Continue.dev has been acquired by Cursor. No download button, no sign-up, no roadmap.
Concerns about 'buying and shutting down open source projects'
Continue was an open-source AI coding assistant with 34,000 GitHub stars
